schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Routine dev-tooling bumps arrive as one PR a week; majors keep their own PR so a breaking esbuild/eslint/jsdom lands reviewable on its own.

The CodeMirror editor bundle moves as a unit (src/editor.js is bundled from these) — bumping them apart produces peer-version skew inside one esbuild bundle. Listed after the devDependencies rule so this groupName wins.

elkjs and js-yaml are vendored into dist/netdiagram.html. An elkjs bump can move layout coordinates and fail the byte-exact golden SVGs — expect to review the diff and re-run npm run test:golden. Extra soak time before the PR opens.
Workflow action bumps (actions/checkout, upload-artifact, deploy-pages, renovatebot/github-action itself) in a single PR.
